description: This is a Python source file implementing a WebRTC-based conversational pipeline with audio processing, LLM integration, and event handling for participant join/leave events.

classes.description: Handles daily transport communication, including participant transcription capture and event handling.

classes.description: Text-to-speech service for generating spoken responses.

classes.description: OpenAI language model service for generating conversational responses.

classes.description: Maintains context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs context with user and assistant response aggregators.

classes.description: Defines strategies for user turn handling.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when to stop user turns based on analysis.
